sloka: मध्ये लवणतोयस्य विघ्नोऽयमिति निश्चितः ।स तमुच्छ्रित मत्यर्थं महावेगो महाकपिः ॥५-१-१०८॥
transliteration: madhye lavaṇatoyasya vighno'yamiti niścitaḥ ।sa tamucchrita matyarthaṁ mahāvego mahākapiḥ ॥5-1-108॥

translations.english: The great vanara,who was swift in action felled down the mountain that had risen high instantly with his chest just as the wind would strike a cloud.
